module: "Spatial" performance telemetry tracker: links framerate to where the player is. It polls the instantaneous FPS every 0.13 s (in a tracked level, world ready, window in the foreground, simulation not paused) and emits, according to the server config (performanceSpatial module): "performanceDip" (FPS drop detected by performanceSpatialDetector, with the snapshot of the worst moment), "performanceSpatial" (periodic position/performance samples and final exposure), "shaderGeneration" (newly generated shaders), "vehicleRecovery" (vehicle recoveries) and "gameplayActivityExit" (activity exit, via performanceSpatialGameplayExit). Each feature can be enabled separately.
notes: If no feature is enabled, onExtensionLoaded returns false (the tracker does not stay loaded). If only recovery or activity-exit tracking are active, the onUpdate hook is removed.

When the window loses focus, the simulation is paused, the world is not ready (worldReadyState ~= 2) or the level is not tracked, the context is closed (the last dip is emitted, along with a final exposure) and reset.
Activity exit deduplication: the same type:id key is not re-emitted within 5 s; for worldExit/gameExit, a mission already finished (aggregated attempt) is not reported as abandoned.

The exit hooks (onAnyMissionChanged, onMissionAttemptAggregated, onRecoveryPromptButtonPressed, onGameplayActivityAborted, onClientPreEndMission, onPreExit) are added or removed dynamically according to the gameplayExitTrackingEnabled option; their entries in the extension's function table therefore do not always exist.
On a Lua reload, onSerialize saves completedMissionId and the detector state (eventCount, cooldownUntilMs) to restore them via onExtensionLoaded(data).
trackVehReset is not an engine hook: it is called by other modules (for example on a vehicle reset); it does nothing if recovery tracking is disabled or if the level is not tracked.

trackVehReset.desc: Records a "vehicleRecovery" event (level and position of player 0's vehicle) if recovery tracking is enabled and the level is tracked.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: at each 0.13 s interval, reads the instantaneous FPS, detects drops, counts generated shaders and emits spatial samples.

dtSim.desc: Simulated delta time (s); <= 0 closes the context.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called on load: reads the performanceSpatial module config, enables the requested features, prepares the detector and the active GPU, restores the state from a Lua reload.

data.desc: onSerialize data from a previous reload (completedMissionId, eventCount, cooldownUntilMs).

returns.desc: false if no feature is enabled (the extension unloads itself).

onSerialize.desc: Hook called before unload: for a Lua reload, closes the context and returns the state to restore.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook called at the end of the level: closes the current context (last dip and final exposure).

onExit.desc: Hook called when the game exits: closes the current context.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook called on unload: closes the current context.
